label: rem:down-quark-properties
title: Down quark: mass splitting and isolation
html:
Remark. Down quark: mass splitting and isolation

Mass splitting. The up and down quarks possess the same knot type and environment. The mass difference \mu_{\mathfrak{d}} - \mu_{\mathfrak{u}} arises from crossing asymmetry. The Skein relation weights positive crossings by q and negative crossings by q^{-1}. The reversed-orientation component therefore carries a distinct Skein resolution energy.

Isolation. Like the up quark, the down quark cannot be isolated. It labels a Borromean component rather than a free particle.
